headline: Central Bank of Brazil Releases Quarterly Credit Conditions Survey
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil has published its latest Quarterly Credit Conditions Survey evaluating domestic credit supply and demand.
why: The Central Bank of Brazil regulates monetary policy and financial institutions in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: The central bank issued its quarterly assessment of domestic lending and credit conditions.
